_doc: Human names for Modern Office 32x32 Singles. Keys match catalog id (mo_single_...) or _file basename. Denizen does not know sprite names without this file.
_howto: 1) Label sprites you place in scenes  2) Key byFile with PNG basename or byId with mo_single_NNN  3) Re-run node scripts/build-modern-office-singles-catalog.js
